author.name: Horace Chan
author.headline: Expert in applying AI in verification

text:
I feel so frustrated that when I am filing my tax return, I still have to everything by hand, download the pdfs, enter the numbers, do the math.

I am so used to use AI for everything at work, our AI pipeline is clean.  AI can see everything and touch on anything just like a human at work. 

Out there in the real world, there is still a huge friction to let AI see and touch like a human.
